Paper: Mohammadzadeh, M.; Bello, A.; Lassen, S. B.; Brandt, K. K.; Risteelä, S.; Leiviskä, T. Pilot-scale adsorption of pharmaceuticals from municipal wastewater effluent using low-cost magnetite-pine bark: Regeneration/enumeration of viable bacteria with a study on their biotoxicity.
Relevance to continuum: High-value cross-cutting evidence for low-concentration real municipal MBR effluent, mixed antibiotics/pharmaceuticals, small and pilot columns, regeneration, bacterial effects, iron leaching and author-estimated material costs.
